note: The T-shaped building north of the Dom (building=church, no name in OSM): the orthophoto (DOP20, 0.2 m) shows rows of small dormers, ~2 m wide, on both slopes of the east-west wing (4.5 m apart: 6 on the north slope, 5 on the south) and 6 on the east slope of the north-south wing (~3 m apart). The roofs themselves stay LoD2's. Dormer positions read off the orthophoto in map cells, as EPSG:25832.
